t:
That the Comprehensive Employment and Training Act (29 U.S.C. 801 et seq) is amended by inserting after section 468 the following new section:


“earle c. clements job corps center
“Sec. 469. 
The Secretary shall designate the Job Corps facilities located in the State of Kentucky in Union County and Muhlenburg County as the ‘Earle C. Clements Job Corps Center’. Any reference in law, map, regulation, document, record, or other paper of the United States to the Job Corps facilities specified in the first sentence of this section shall be held to be a reference to the ‘Earle C. Clements Job Corps Center’.”.

fable.w: This section only directs the Secretary to name Job Corps facilities and provides that references in U.S. documents refer to the new name. The word "regulation" appears only in a boilerplate list of documents whose references are deemed updated; it does not authorize rulemaking. No party outside the federal government is consulted or given any role in a federal decision.
fable.s: The Secretary shall designate the Job Corps facilities located in the State of Kentucky in Union County and Muhlenburg County as the ‘Earle C. Clements Job Corps Center’.

opus.w: This section only directs the Secretary to name certain Job Corps facilities. No one outside the federal government is consulted, given a hearing, asked to comment, or given a right to sue. The word "regulation" might look like a grant of rulemaking power, but it only appears in a list of existing documents that must use the new name. It does not authorize any new rulemaking.
opus.s: The Secretary shall designate the Job Corps facilities located in the State of Kentucky in Union County and Muhlenburg County as the ‘Earle C. Clements Job Corps Center’.

qwen_chat.w: This section mandates the Secretary to rename specific Job Corps facilities. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. The decision is a unilateral administrative action directed by Congress, with no input from the public, states, or other external entities.
qwen_chat.s: The Secretary shall designate the Job Corps facilities located in the State of Kentucky in Union County and Muhlenburg County as the ‘Earle C. Clements Job Corps Center’.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that naming a facility after a person involves some form of public recognition or consultation, but the text itself contains no procedural requirement for outside parties to participate in the decision. The section is purely administrative, directing the Secretary to change the name of existing facilities. There is no mention of public comment, advisory boards, consultation with states or tribes, or any other mechanism for outside participation. The decision is made unilaterally by the Secretary as mandated by Congress.
